dct_title_s: Sunda Strait and approaches, eastern archipelago : from Netherland Government surveys to 1934
dct_description_sm: Nautical chart of Sunda Strait and approaches in Indonesia. Relief shown by contours and spot heights. Depth shown by bathymetric soundings.
In lower left margin: Small corrections: Printed: ... Dec. '42, XII '42.
dct_publisher_sm: Published Mar. 1889, at the Hydrographic Office, under the authority of the Secretary of the Navy
